story_type: castaways on a remote cay for weeks, supply drop then basket hoist
hook: Stranded on a tiny island for 33 days.
narration: Two men and a woman were reportedly stranded on a tiny island in the Bahamas for thirty three days.
The island was Anguilla Cay. The Coast Guard reached them on February ninth, 2021.
First, an Ocean Sentry plane from Air Station Miami dropped them food, water and a radio.
The radio let the crew talk to them from the air.
Then a Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Clearwater came in over the rocks.
The flight mechanic runs the hoist from the open door and watches the basket the whole way, because the pilots can't see straight down.
One by one, the basket brought them up to the door.
outcome: The crew hoisted all three and flew them to Lower Keys Medical Center with no reported injuries.
title: Stranded 33 days on a Bahamas island
description:
On Feb. 9, 2021, Coast Guard crews from Air Station Miami and Air Station Clearwater rescued three people who had reportedly been stranded on Anguilla Cay, Bahamas, for 33 days.
